notes: SSRN primary abstract and metadata read on 23 September 2026; written 2 August and posted 11 August 2026. Authors claim an exact level-20 certificate giving ancestor-count exponent 0.914947 and a smallest Syracuse atom bound c_n >> (3t)^(-n), t=10449/10000. Full paper and certificate have not been obtained or independently checked here. These are attributed preprint claims, not established laboratory inputs. Under the existing normalized-cell identification, the latter advertised bound gives only a summable geometric minorant. See docs/problems/collatz_fibre_critical_minorants.md. The laboratory's small complete-transfer certificates are a separate calculation; no identity with the authors' full KL operator is asserted.
title: A Certified Density Exponent for the 3x + 1 Problem and the Smallest Atom of the Syracuse Random Variable
